statements.statement: School Committee heard significant public comment about the recent override defeat, school funding concerns, athletic and music program concerns, and the need for transparency around future budget decisions.
School Committee discussed potential additional state aid and potentially a special town meeting ahead of the school year.
Letter to the conference committee, read into the record, states the House and Senate increased minimum Chapter 70 aid from the governor's proposed $75 per pupil to $160 per pupil.
Letter to the conference committee requests funding at the higher of the House and Senate proposed levels for special education circuit breaker reimbursement and unrestricted general government aid.
